Therefore, he delivered them into custody for three days.

it is held in the sack.”
And they were astonished and troubled,
and they said to one another,
Quidnam est hoc quod fecit nobis Deus?
“What is this that God has done to us?”
Veneruntque ad Jacob patrem suum in terram Chanaan,
And they went to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan,
et narraverunt ei omnia quæ accidissent sibi,
and they explained to him all the things that had befallen them,

“The lord of the land spoke harshly to us,
et putavit nos exploratores esse provinciæ.
and he considered us to be scouts of the province.
